decisions.reason: The source establishes the required conclusion of the user-funded versus availability-payment comparison: user fees alone must be shown as insufficient for viability or bankability.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Although the model is being finalized, its figures remain projections. At this stage, the main objective is to give the government sufficiently robust financial evidence that an availability-style payment is necessary. The model must clearly show that user fees alone cannot make the project viable or bankable.

value_updates.required_comparison_conclusion: The user-funded case must show that user fees alone cannot make the project viable or bankable, supporting the necessity of an availability-style payment.
